status_scope: status=submitted and preview=true record the generation-time engineering submission, not the live acceptance state of a later published version.

acceptance_binding.authority: External exact-SHA integration gate plus final public version/release description
acceptance_binding.lookup_rule: Evaluate the exact current file digest and published commit against that external gate; do not infer current non-acceptance from generation-time labels.
acceptance_binding.binding_note: Filled by the external release/version record after the sole-writer integration and independent gate, without a self-referential hash claim.

scope: Derived engineering view of existing evidence; formal integration gate is external. No new experiments or independent semantic gate.

state_enum.supported: end-to-end realized output with verification evidence bound to THIS entity + THIS output dimension in this campaign
state_enum.conditional: partial / historical / route-limited / receipt-limited evidence; output or declaration exists but an explicit unmet condition remains (channel DOWN, renderer substitution, PRE-milestone-only, not E4-validated, receipt not accepted)
state_enum.unsupported: the output route is not applicable / explicitly excluded for this entity (e.g. a still image cannot substitute for motion delivery); a declared non-route, NOT a failed test
state_enum.untested: no output realized and no test performed for this entity+dimension in this campaign; no evidence either way

dimensions.image: static image / image-generation OUTPUT (realized visual output via the image channel). A text image-prompt brief, an AUDIT receipt, a module card, or a §8.1b section is NOT an image output.
dimensions.web10s: 10-second web animation (10s / 300-frame motion delivered via the web/HTML renderer route). A dependency-free local procedural rasterizer (no browser/compositor) is a conditional, not a full web-route, realization.
dimensions.blender: Blender scene/render OUTPUT (blender -b pipeline realization). A 'Blender brief' text spec is not a render.

traceability_rules: Each cell uses only its own entity/output evidence.
Text/brief/draft is not an implemented output.
Local raster is partial evidence, not browser route certification.
Seed engineering prototypes do not satisfy parent E2/E3 or activate the domain.
Receipt/review labels and source hashes preserve lineage; they are not new independent semantic review.
Unsupported means declared non-route; it is not a failed experiment.

headline.note: Counts are computed from cells, with no required supported count.
